0022600170.text: The Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) visit the Warriors (4-3, on a four-game winning streak) with Phoenix 0-2 on the road and sitting 12th in the West, 2 games back in the Pacific, while Golden State is 2nd in the Pacific, half a game back, and 9th in the West. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury that required surgery, while Golden State is without Draymond Green (rest), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Stephen Curry (rest). The Suns lead this season's series 1-0 after a 131-122 win in Phoenix on October 24, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
